verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents an experimental flyctl MCP server that can be added to an MCP client's configuration. This gives AI agents a first-party path to operate flyctl on the user's behalf, so natural-language operation works only through an external AI client and is marked experimental. There is no native natural-language interface in the CLI or dashboard. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of which flyctl operations the MCP server exposes, non-experimental status, and hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
